additional_sources.guard: Dataset metadata states European Commission as author, EUTL verified emissions, year and tonnes_co2 fields, CC-BY-4.0. Numeric promotion still requires an installation object with explicit EUTL ID and exact year/value row.

additional_sources.title: Drax - EUTL ID 96842 verified emissions
additional_sources.guard: Object binds Drax to EUTL ID 96842 and explicit 2005-2020 tonnes CO2 rows. Historical verified installation rows only; no parcel geometry inference and no annual-output/intensity substitution.

additional_sources.title: Spalding - EUTL ID 96864 verified emissions

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_AUTHORITY: Dataset authority and schema establish provenance but do not substitute for an installation row.
guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Promotion requires explicit EUTL installation ID, year, tonnes CO2 quantity and direct object-row match. Historical verified emissions remain installation-level and are not current-year or parcel values.

web_research_basis: Fresh internet verification on 2026-07-27. Power Station Dictionary metadata identifies the verified-emissions dataset as EUTL data authored by the European Commission, with account_id, year and tonnes_co2 fields. Drax, Immingham CHP, South Humber Bank and Spalding objects each expose an EUTL ID plus explicit 2005-2020 annual CO2 tonnes. No interpolation, OCR, intensity conversion, current-year extrapolation or parcel inference is used.
